headword: {国民|こくみん}の{祝日|しゅくじつ}
reading: こくみんのしゅくじつ

definitions.explanation: An officially designated public holiday in Japan. Defined by the National Holiday Law (国民の祝日に関する法律). Japan currently has 16 national holidays throughout the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国民|こくみん}の{祝日|しゅくじつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧だ。
examples.english: Tomorrow is a national holiday so we have the day off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧16⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国民|こくみん}の{祝日|しゅくじつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japan has 16 national holidays per year.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}の{祝日|しゅくじつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧「ハッピーマンデー⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧」⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The 'Happy Monday' system, which moves national holidays to Mondays, has increased the number of long weekends.

notes:
The official term for Japan's legally designated public holidays, as defined by the {国民|こくみん}の{祝日|しゅくじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧ (Act on National Holidays). In everyday speech, people often just say ⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧.

JAPAN'S 16 NATIONAL HOLIDAYS:
- ⟦{元日|がんじつ}→元日：00059_ganjitsu⟧ (Jan 1): New Year's Day
- ⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (2nd Mon Jan): Coming of Age Day
- {建国記念|けんこくきねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Feb 11): National Foundation Day
- {天皇誕生日|てんのうたんじょうび} (Feb 23): Emperor's Birthday
- ⟦{春分|しゅんぶん}の{日|ひ}→春分の日：18206_shunbunnohi⟧ (Mar ~21): Vernal Equinox Day
- ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Apr 29): Showa Day
- {憲法記念日|けんぽうきねんび} (May 3): Constitution Memorial Day
- みどり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (May 4): Greenery Day
- こども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (May 5): Children's Day
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (3rd Mon Jul): Marine Day
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Aug 11): Mountain Day
- ⟦{敬老|けいろう}の{日|ひ}→敬老の日：15304_keirounohi⟧ (3rd Mon Sep): Respect for the Aged Day
- ⟦{秋分|しゅうぶん}→秋分：19657_shuubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Sep ~23): Autumnal Equinox Day
- ⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (2nd Mon Oct): Sports Day
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Nov 3): Culture Day
- ⟦{勤労感謝|きんろうかんしゃ}→勤労感謝：27517_kinroukansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Nov 23): Labor Thanksgiving Day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧: holiday — the common short form used in everyday speech
- ⟦{祭日|さいじつ}→祭日：04158_saijitsu⟧: festival day — an older term sometimes used interchangeably with ⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧, though strictly they differ
- ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧: day off — broader term for any non-working day, including weekends
